questions.stem: Which of the following is a common property of ionic compounds?
choices: They are usually gases at room temperature
They are good conductors of electricity in solid state
questions.solution: Ionic compounds are composed of ions held together by strong electrostatic forces, which result in a rigid, three-dimensional crystal structure. This arrangement is a fundamental characteristic of ionic bonding. The other options are incorrect because ionic compounds are usually solids at room temperature, have high melting points, and do not conduct electricity in the solid state but do so when melted or dissolved.

hi.stem: निम्नलिखित में से कौन-सा आयनिक यौगिकों का सामान्य गुण है?
choices: वे कमरे के तापमान पर आमतौर पर गैस होते हैं
वे ठोस अवस्था में विद्युत के अच्छे चालक होते हैं

hi.solution: आयनिक यौगिक आयनों से बने होते हैं जो मजबूत विद्युत स्थैतिक बलों द्वारा एक साथ बंधे रहते हैं, जिसके परिणामस्वरूप एक कठोर, त्रिआयामी क्रिस्टल संरचना बनती है। यह आयनिक बंधन की एक मूलभूत विशेषता है। अन्य विकल्प गलत हैं क्योंकि आयनिक यौगिक कमरे के तापमान पर आमतौर पर ठोस होते हैं, उनके उच्च गलनांक होते हैं, और ठोस अवस्था में विद्युत के चालक नहीं होते लेकिन गलित या घुलित अवस्था में होते हैं।
hi.critique: Translation is accurate, maintains original meaning, and uses standard Hindi scientific terminology.

mr.stem: खालीलपैकी कोणता अयोनिक द्रव्यांचा सामान्य गुणधर्म आहे?
choices: ते घन अवस्थेत विद्युत चालक असतात
mr.solution: अयोनिक द्रव्ये आयनांच्या एकत्रित बांधामुळे बनतात, ज्यामुळे त्यांच्यात शक्तिशाली विद्युतस्थितीय बल असतात आणि त्यांची एक बल्कट, त्रिविमीय क्रिस्टल संरचना बनते. ही अयोनिक बंधनाची आधारभूत वैशिष्ट्ये आहे. इतर विकल्प अयोग्य आहेत कारण अयोनिक द्रव्ये सामान्यतः कमी तापमानावर घन असतात, त्यांचे उच्च द्रवणांक असतात आणि घन अवस्थेत विद्युत चालक नसतात परंतु ते द्रव अवस्थेत किंवा विरघळलेल्या अवस्थेत विद्युत चालक असतात.
mr.critique: The Marathi translation is accurate, maintains the same meaning, and uses appropriate technical terms as used in Marathi-medium textbooks.

questions.stem: Which of the following is a property of ionic compounds?
choices: They do not conduct electricity in the solid state
They form molecules in solid state
They are always soluble in water
questions.solution: Ionic compounds do not conduct electricity in the solid state because their ions are held in fixed positions. The other options are incorrect because ionic compounds have high melting points, do not form molecules, and are not always soluble in water.

questions.stem: What is the formula unit mass of sodium oxide (Na₂O)?
questions.solution: The formula unit mass of sodium oxide is calculated as (23 u × 2) + (16 u × 1) = 62 u. The other options are incorrect because they do not account for both sodium and oxygen atoms in the correct proportions.

hi.critique: Translation is accurate and maintains the original meaning, technical terms are appropriate for Hindi-medium curriculum.

questions.stem: What does the Law of Conservation of Mass state?
choices: Matter can be created and destroyed in a chemical reaction.
Matter is conserved in a chemical reaction.
Mass changes in a chemical reaction.
Only energy is conserved in a chemical reaction.
questions.solution: The correct option states that matter is conserved in a chemical reaction, which aligns with the principle that mass remains constant during such processes. The other options are incorrect because they suggest matter can be created or destroyed, which violates the fundamental idea of conservation, or claim only energy is conserved, which is not the focus of the Law of Conservation of Mass.

hi.stem: क्या द्रव्यमान के संरक्षण के नियम का कहना है?
choices: रासायनिक अभिक्रिया में द्रव्य का निर्माण और नाश हो सकता है।
रासायनिक अभिक्रिया में द्रव्य संरक्षित रहता है।
रासायनिक अभिक्रिया में द्रव्यमान बदल जाता है।
केवल ऊर्जा ही रासायनिक अभिक्रिया में संरक्षित रहती है।
hi.solution: सही विकल्प बताता है कि रासायनिक अभिक्रिया में द्रव्य संरक्षित रहता है, जो ऐसी प्रक्रियाओं में द्रव्यमान स्थिर रहता है, इस सिद्धांत के साथ मेल खाता है। अन्य विकल्प गलत हैं क्योंकि वे द्रव्य के निर्माण या नाश के बारे में कहते हैं, जो संरक्षण के मूलभूत विचार के विरुद्ध है, या यह कहते हैं कि केवल ऊर्जा ही संरक्षित रहती है, जो द्रव्यमान के संरक्षण के नियम के केंद्रीय विषय के विरुद्ध है।
hi.critique: The Hindi translation accurately reflects the English original in meaning, structure, and terminology. All options are correctly translated, and the correct answer remains in the same position. The distractors remain incorrect and distinct. Technical terms like 'द्रव्यमान' (mass), 'द्रव्य' (matter), and 'रासायनिक अभिक्रिया' (chemical reaction) are standard in Hindi science education.

mr.stem: काय वस्तुमानाच्या संरक्षणाच्या कायद्याचा अर्थ आहे?
choices: रासायनिक अभिक्रियेत द्रव्य तयार केले जाऊ शकते आणि नष्ट होऊ शकते.

questions.stem: What does the Law of Definite Proportions state about chemical compounds?
choices: They can contain elements in any ratio by mass
They always contain elements in fixed ratios by mass
They can only contain two elements
They are always made up of the same type of atoms
questions.solution: The correct answer is 'They always contain elements in fixed ratios by mass.' This is a fundamental principle of chemistry, where the composition of a compound is consistent regardless of its source or method of preparation. The other options are incorrect because compounds can contain more than two elements, and they are made up of different types of atoms, not the same type.

questions.stem: What type of chemical bond is present in a solid compound that does not conduct electricity in the solid state but conducts electricity when dissolved in water?
questions.solution: The correct answer is ionic bond. Ionic compounds do not conduct electricity in the solid state because their ions are fixed in position. However, when dissolved in water, the ions become free to move, allowing the solution to conduct electricity. A student might confuse this with covalent bonds, thinking that all compounds that dissolve in water conduct electricity, but covalent compounds do not form ions and therefore do not conduct electricity. A metallic bond would allow conduction in the solid state, and hydrogen bonds do not involve ion movement.

hi.stem: ठोस यौगिक में कौन-सा रासायनिक बंध उपस्थित होता है जो ठोस अवस्था में विद्युत का चालन नहीं करता है लेकिन पानी में घुले हुए अवस्था में विद्युत का चालन करता है?

questions.stem: If a compound has a mass ratio of 40% sulfur and 60% oxygen, how much oxygen is required to combine with 20 g of sulfur?
questions.solution: According to the Law of Constant Proportions, the mass ratio of elements in a compound is fixed. If sulfur is 40% and oxygen is 60%, then for every 40 g of sulfur, 60 g of oxygen is needed. So, for 20 g of sulfur, 30 g of oxygen is required. This follows the ratio 40:60 or 2:3.
